status: analysis-level amendment; frozen config/protocol.json and raw outputs unchanged (raw stores rank per token)
primary_metric: log10(1/rank) = -log10(rank) of the gold name token (0 = rank 1, -1 = rank 10, min -5.18)
within_paper: sum over all scored tokens of log10(1/rank) (sum_nlr) to compare layers/readouts for the same paper (identical token set); sum_rr (sum 1/rank) kept as supplementary
between_papers_and_groups: mean log10(1/rank) per token (mean_nlr) and mean over authors of per-author mean (author_mean_nlr); never sums
reason: 1/rank only sees the top few ranks; log rank captures multiplicative climbs (50000 -> 500) across layers; sums depend on the number of authors/tokens (target 4.0, control 3.2, guard 2.2 authors on average)

grouping.labels: group_tight (target / control / guard / excluded) from zhiqi_qwen3-32b_labels_2026-10-15
grouping.A_descriptive: group_tight x 13 citation bins x readout x layer, with n
grouping.B_primary_contrast: target - control within citation bin, pooled with weights n_t*n_c/(n_t+n_c) over bins with >= 30 papers in both groups; bootstrap papers within bin x group (2000)
grouping.C_graded: mc_team_a 0..4 among R0/R1, metric centred within citation bin; per-level means and Spearman
grouping.D_ladder: papers with >= 129 citations: guard vs target vs control; guard - target within bin (>= 10 per cell)
grouping.E_citation: Spearman of metric vs log10(citations+1) within target, control, guard
sensitivity: drop bins 0-2 and 3-4 (target near 25% fixed-preference rate)
strata citation_bin x field (>= 10 per cell)
